subject: Audit log handover — export checklist & timelines
messages:
From: Daniela Rodriguez <daniela.rodriguez@brightpath.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Cc: security@brightpath.com
Date: Wed, 7 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: audit/access log handover checklist and timelines

Hi Jordan —

Hope you’re well. BrightPath is preparing its audit pack for an upcoming regulatory review and we need to confirm what Redwood can provide for tenant-level audit and access logs. Can you confirm: 

1) Which export formats you support for audit/access logs (JSONL, CSV, syslog, S3 delivery, etc.)
2) Typical retention windows for audit logs in hosted vs. dedicated environments (we need 24 months for the fedgov program)
3) How fast you can produce a bulk export (SLA or typical lead time) and whether exports can be incremental (cursor-based)
4) Whether you provide immutable/tombstone markers and deletion evidence when records are purged
5) Encryption and KMS details for exported buckets and at-rest copies

Also, if there’s a short checklist or manifest we can attach to our audit binder that describes the export process and expected artifacts, that would be helpful.

Thanks — please loop anyone required on your side.

— Daniela
Security & Compliance Program Manager
BrightPath Health
From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
To: Daniela Rodriguez <daniela.rodriguez@brightpath.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Oct 2026 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: audit/access log handover checklist and timelines

Hi Daniela —

Thanks for the clear list. Below is a concise summary and next steps; I’ve attached a short checklist (audit_export_checklist.xlsx) and a sample manifest (access_log_manifest.json) for your binder. If anything needs more detail we can spin up a call with product/ops.

Quick answers:
- Formats: bulk exports available as gzipped JSONL or CSV; near-real-time streaming via syslog (TLS) or S3/HTTPS delivery. We also support NDJSON for structured event payloads.
- Retention: Hosted tenants default to 90 days; Dedicated customers can configure retention up to 36 months via contract. We can accommodate a 24-month retention for BrightPath on Dedicated (requires provisioned capacity + retention addendum).
- Lead times / SLA: Standard bulk exports are delivered within 3 business days for requests < 1TB; for larger handovers (1–10TB) typical delivery is 5–10 business days. We offer expedited handovers (1–2 business days) as a paid service in enterprise SLAs. Incremental exports are supported via a cursor/timestamp mechanism; manifest files include start/end cursors.
- Deletion evidence: When logs are expired/deleted we produce a tombstone CSV that lists record ranges removed with timestamps. For contractual/legal holds, we can freeze retention policies and provide an export and signed attestation.
- Encryption / keys: Exports to S3 are server-side encrypted (SSE-S3) by default; for enterprise customers we support SSE-KMS with customer-managed CMKs and HSM-backed keys on request. All files are transmitted over HTTPS/TLS and stored encrypted at rest.

Action items:
1) Naomi — confirm Dedicated retention addendum language and whether current provisioning covers 24 months. (Naomi: can you reply with contract language we’d need?)
2) Marissa — confirm operational lead time for a 2TB handover and whether we can offer a 48-hr expedited window under our enterprise SLA. (Marissa: can you check with ops and storage team?)
3) Jordan — I’ll schedule a 30-min walkthrough if BrightPath wants a demo of the export flow.

Attachments: audit_export_checklist.xlsx (checklist + artifacts expected), access_log_manifest.json (example manifest format with cursors).

Onwards —
Jordan Blake
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
jordan@redwood.com

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 8 Oct 2026 08:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: audit/access log handover checklist and timelines

Hi all —

Quick clarifications from product/operations:

- Retention by environment: Hosted (default 90 days, cannot extend per-tenant without migration to Dedicated). Dedicated: configurable through policy up to 36 months. We can add an addendum to the contract for 24 months.
- Export formats: Confirming Jordan’s note — we provide gzipped JSONL and CSV slices, and a syslog streaming option. The manifest includes: tenant_id, time_range, start_cursor, end_cursor, total_records, sha256_checksum for each file chunk.
- Chunking: For >100GB we chunk into 50GB gz files and provide an index/manifest. This keeps transfer and rehydration reliable.
- Deletion evidence & legal hold: If required, we can generate a signed deletion certificate (PDF) and a tombstone index. Legal hold will pause deletion workflows; you must supply a legal hold id and duration.
- PII redaction: Exports contain raw audit events. If you require PII redaction we can run a redaction pass prior to export; note this increases lead time and is treated as a scoped compliance engagement.
- Encryption/KMS: We require an ACL + KMS key policy for customer CMKs. We can support cross-account S3 delivery; ops will provide a presigned upload bucket or accept push to your bucket via a temporary role.
- Access controls: Exports are staged to a temporary S3 bucket with one-week TTL for retrieval; we keep an access log and will rotate URLs. For very large handovers we can do offline transfer (physical or partner transfer) but that’s rare.

Marissa — can you confirm the 2TB expedited delivery feasibility and provide an ops contact for handovers?

Daniela — if you can confirm desired retention (24 months) and whether PII redaction is required, we’ll produce a formal addendum and a time-bound delivery estimate.

Thanks —
Naomi Feldman
Head of Compliance | Redwood Inference
naomi@redwood.com

Subject: Audit log export checklist, artifacts, and proposed timeline

Hi Daniela —

Thanks for the quick responses. Below is the formalized checklist and proposed timeline assuming BrightPath wants a 24-month Dedicated handover, ~2TB of data, and no PII redaction. If PII redaction is required we’ll need an extra 3–5 business days.

Checklist (deliverables):
- Signed retention addendum (24 months) — legal
- Export request form (tenant_id, start/end timestamps, desired format) — supplied by customer or via our portal
- Export manifest (JSON) listing chunks, cursors, checksums — provided by Redwood
- Chunked data files (gzipped JSONL or CSV) — delivered to customer S3 or Redwood staging bucket
- Tombstone index + deletion certificate (PDF) if retention purge has occurred during the requested range
- Signed attestation of export integrity (SHA256) — ops
- KMS key reference and ACL confirmation — security

Proposed timeline (2TB handover, no redaction):
- Day 0: Receipt of signed addendum + export request form + S3 bucket/perms
- Day 1–2: Ops staging, manifest generation, and chunk planning
- Day 3–4: Export generation and upload to staging bucket (3 business days typical for <1TB, 4–6 for 1–3TB depending on queue)
- Day 5: Transfer verification, checksum attestation, close-out PDF delivered

Expedited option: We can offer a 48-hour expedited workflow for an additional fee (requires ops bandwidth and storage priority).

Next steps:
1) Daniela — confirm desired export format (JSONL preferred) and bucket details or whether you want Redwood to stage and push.
2) Daniela — confirm whether PII redaction or legal hold is required.
3) Naomi/Marissa — please confirm ops lead and a firm estimate for the 48-hr expedited turnaround cost.

I’m happy to do a short walkthrough or hop on a call with your security team — let me know availability.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
jordan@redwood.com
